comment: W3C SVG 1.1 compliance tracker for the vendored reference-image subset (plan Phase 4). W3C results are report-only and never a merge gate (plan decision 2b #13); run tests/tools/run_w3c.py to refresh.
issueField: Reserved for a tracker issue reference; empty until a specific issue is filed for the gap. 'seenIn' records where the case came from in the prototype (w3c_ignore.json mustMatch[] or the filters-* download list).

policy.comment: Render the case at the suite's 480x360 reference size on a transparent background and compare RGB within the anti-aliased tolerance. Alpha is ignored because the W3C reference rasters encode browser viewport-clipping and stroke anti-aliasing in alpha, which lunasvg reproduces differently.

reference.suite: W3C SVG 1.1 Second Edition Test Suite
